title: ride.status-changed (version 1) - the data part
description: Published by the core on topic ride-events, key = ride id, every time a ride changes status. Consumers: notification, payment, analytics, audit.

driverUserId.description: The driver involved at that moment, if any.

fareTotal.description: The frozen fare, in currency. Money is a decimal number, never a float computed by the consumer.

category.description: BIKE, AUTO or CAB. Added in Phase 14 (optional: older events do not have it).

pickupCell.description: The surge zone of the pickup point. Added in Phase 14.

surgeMultiplier.description: The surge multiplier frozen on the ride. Added in Phase 14.

couponCode.description: The coupon the rider asked to use. Added in Phase 14.
